Footer.legal: © {brand}. Prices exclude tax, title and registration.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: That page doesn’t exist — or the vehicle has already found a new home.

Home.headline: Find the car you’ll love driving.
Home.lead: Every listing shows the exact price and full specs. When you find the one, message us on WhatsApp or give us a call.
Home.priceDropsDescription: Recently reduced — the new price is shown on every card.
Home.recentlySoldDescription: Sold in the last 30 days. Looking for something similar? Ask us.
Home.inStockDescription: Our picks first, then the newest arrivals.

Card.compareFull: You can compare up to {max} vehicles. Remove one first.

Inventory.metaDescription: Search every vehicle with live filters. Each listing shows the exact price and full specs.
Inventory.title: Inventory
Inventory.lead: Exact prices and full specs on every listing. Message us on WhatsApp or call about any car.
Inventory.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
Inventory.noMatchBody: Try removing a filter or widening the price and year range.
Inventory.seenAll: You’ve seen all {count} {count, plural, one {vehicle} other {vehicles}}.
Inventory.newArrivalsTitle: New arrivals are on the way
Inventory.newArrivalsBody: Tell us the make, model and budget you have in mind, and we’ll let you know as soon as a match comes in.
Inventory.newArrivalsMessage: Hi! I’m looking for a car. Can you help me find one?

Filters.noModels: No models in our catalog for this make yet.
Filters.title: Title

Vehicle.metaDescription: {title}: {facts}. Full specs and photos — message us on WhatsApp or call.
Vehicle.soldBody: Take a look at similar vehicles below, or tell us what you’re looking for.
Vehicle.soldMessage: Hi! The {title} sold — do you have anything similar?
Vehicle.similarDescription: Same body style or make, at a similar price.
Vehicle.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the link. Copy it from the address bar instead.
Vehicle.dealerVehicles: See all vehicles from this dealer

Compare.metaDescription: Line up to four vehicles side by side with the differences highlighted.
Compare.title: Compare vehicles
Compare.lead: Up to four vehicles side by side. Rows that differ are highlighted.
Compare.emptyBody: Tap the compare icon on up to four vehicles and they’ll line up here side by side.
Compare.caption: Comparison of {titles}. Highlighted rows differ.
Compare.allMatch: These vehicles match on every listed spec.

SellWithUs.metaDescription: Apply to list your dealership’s inventory on the marketplace.
SellWithUs.title: Put your inventory in front of more car buyers
SellWithUs.lead: Join the marketplace as a partner dealer. Your cars, your prices, your customers.
SellWithUs.perkLeadsBody: Buyers message or call your number from every listing. No middleman, no checkout.
SellWithUs.perkManageBody: Add cars, scan VINs and upload photos from the web console or the mobile app.
SellWithUs.perkListingsBody: Big photos, every spec and price-drop badges on each car, with WhatsApp and Call buttons.
SellWithUs.signInBody: Sign in with your email first. We use it to send your approval and lead notifications.
SellWithUs.pending: Your application is being reviewed. You can prepare draft listings now; they go live once you are approved.
SellWithUs.approved: Your dealership is approved. Manage inventory from the console.
SellWithUs.rejected: Your previous application was not approved.
SellWithUs.documentsHelp: Dealer license, insurance or business registration. PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 20 MB each. Only our review team can see them.
SellWithUs.documentsInvalid: Documents must be PDF, JPEG or PNG files up to 20 MB.
SellWithUs.consent: By applying you confirm you are authorized to sell vehicles on behalf of this business.
SellWithUs.receivedBody: We review new dealerships within one business day. In the meantime you can open the console and prepare draft listings. They go live as soon as you are approved.
SellWithUs.uploadFailed: We could not upload {names}. You can send documents later from your dealer profile.

Saved.title: Saved vehicles
Saved.lead: Tap the heart on any listing to keep it here.
Saved.deviceOnly: Saved on this device only. Sign in to keep them on every device.
Saved.noLongerListed: The vehicles you saved are no longer listed.
Saved.emptyBody: Tap the heart on a listing to save it for later.

Errors.title: Something went wrong
Errors.body: We couldn’t load this page. Please try again — if it keeps happening, call or WhatsApp us.

Dealer.metaDescription: {count} vehicles from {dealer}. Exact prices and full specs.
Dealer.none: No vehicles listed right now — check back soon.

Contact.title: Talk to us
Contact.lead: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp. Prefer to talk? Give us a call.
